about: Shared Rust/TypeScript parity vectors for ch_math::portfolio + ch_math::risk. Inputs are hand-written; every 'expect' block is generated by `CH_UPDATE_VECTORS=1 cargo test -p ch_math --test vectors` and must never be hand-edited. Integers are decimal strings. Both crates/ch_math/tests/vectors.rs and testbench/src/vectors.test.ts assert every case.
